units.contents:
[Unit]
Description=Scrypted-scoped Watchtower updater
Wants=network-online.target
After=network-online.target docker.service
Requires=docker.service

[Service]
EnvironmentFile=/etc/scrypted/scrypted.env
TimeoutStartSec=0
ExecStartPre=-/usr/bin/docker rm --force scrypted-watchtower
ExecStartPre=/usr/bin/docker pull nickfedor/watchtower
ExecStart=/usr/bin/docker run --name scrypted-watchtower \
  --label com.centurylinklabs.watchtower.scope=scrypted \
  --env WATCHTOWER_HTTP_API_TOKEN \
  --env WATCHTOWER_HTTP_API_UPDATE=true \
  --env WATCHTOWER_SCOPE=scrypted \
  --env WATCHTOWER_HTTP_API_PERIODIC_POLLS=true \
  --volume /var/run/docker.sock:/var/run/docker.sock \
  --publish 127.0.0.1:10444:8080 \
  --dns 10.10.10.53 \
  --log-driver journald \
  nickfedor/watchtower --interval 3600 --cleanup --scope scrypted
ExecStop=-/usr/bin/docker stop --time 30 scrypted-watchtower
Restart=always
RestartSec=10
StandardOutput=journal
StandardError=journal

[Install]
WantedBy=multi-user.target
units.name: scrypted-watchtower.service

units.contents:
[Unit]
Description=Scrypted NVR
ConditionPathExists=/dev/disk/by-id/wwn-0x5000000000000001-part1
ConditionPathExists=/dev/disk/by-id/wwn-0x5000000000000002-part1
ConditionPathExists=!/etc/scrypted/disable-auto-recovery
Wants=network-online.target scrypted-watchtower.service
After=network-online.target docker.service scrypted-watchtower.service var-lib-scrypted-nvr.mount var-lib-scrypted-nvr2.mount
Requires=docker.service var-lib-scrypted-nvr.mount var-lib-scrypted-nvr2.mount

[Service]
EnvironmentFile=/etc/scrypted/scrypted.env
TimeoutStartSec=0
ExecStartPre=/usr/bin/mountpoint --quiet /var/lib/scrypted/nvr
ExecStartPre=/usr/bin/mountpoint --quiet /var/lib/scrypted/nvr2
ExecStartPre=/usr/bin/test -d /dev/dri
ExecStartPre=-/usr/bin/docker rm --force scrypted
ExecStartPre=/bin/sh -ec 'if /usr/bin/ss -H -lun "sport = :5353" | /usr/bin/grep -q .; then echo "UDP 5353 already occupied; refusing Scrypted HomeKit startup" >&2; exit 1; fi'
ExecStartPre=/usr/bin/docker pull ghcr.io/koush/scrypted
ExecStart=/usr/bin/docker run --name scrypted \
  --network host \
  --device /dev/dri:/dev/dri \
  --mount type=bind,source=/var/lib/scrypted/volume,target=/server/volume \
  --mount type=bind,source=/var/lib/scrypted/nvr,target=/nvr \
  --mount type=bind,source=/var/lib/scrypted/nvr2,target=/nvr2 \
  --env SCRYPTED_NVR_VOLUME=/nvr \
  --env SCRYPTED_DOCKER_AVAHI=true \
  --env SCRYPTED_WEBHOOK_UPDATE_AUTHORIZATION \
  --env SCRYPTED_WEBHOOK_UPDATE=http://127.0.0.1:10444/v1/update \
  --label com.centurylinklabs.watchtower.scope=scrypted \
  --dns 10.10.10.53 \
  --log-driver none \
  ghcr.io/koush/scrypted
ExecStop=-/usr/bin/docker stop --time 30 scrypted
Restart=always
RestartSec=10
StandardOutput=journal
StandardError=journal

[Install]
WantedBy=multi-user.target
units.name: scrypted.service

[Unit]
Description=Retry Scrypted after recording storage returns

[Timer]
OnCalendar=minutely
AccuracySec=1s
Unit=scrypted.service

[Install]
WantedBy=timers.target
units.name: scrypted-recovery.timer
